summary: Smoke-tested the pure refactor of CycleTrackingPage.js (1343→1005 lines) and DragDropComponents.jsx (1261→727 lines). Home page mounts without React crash; sections render with i18n labels, ITEM_ICONS badge icons, and ITEM_STYLES linear-gradient backgrounds (6 gradient elements detected). Login + page load show no NEW console errors — only pre-existing 401 'Erreur chargement layout' and 404 resource errors carried over from iteration_55. Static import audit confirms all 5 extracted cycle sub-components (SymptomsModal, CycleHistoryModal, InitialSetupModal, CycleReportModal, PregnancyToggle) plus cycle/constants.js and dragdrop/constants.js are imported correctly in their parents. Extracted SymptomsModal preserves data-testids (mood-happy, symptom-cramps, symptoms-save-btn, symptoms-modal-close) and PregnancyToggle preserves data-testid='pregnant-button' + data-testid='dpa-card' with identical DPA = lastPeriodDate + 280 days logic. The previously-validated drill-down flow (iteration_55 confirmed pregnant-button + DPA card + 'Félicitations' rendering) is structurally preserved; the runtime drill-down click chain (En route vers la grossesse → Cycles tile → /cycle-tracking) requires multi-step expansion in the journey UI plus dismissal of a 9-step onboarding tour which blocked deep interaction in this iteration's automation. No regressions detected at the refactor level.

critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: SymptomsModal.jsx (137 lines), PregnancyToggle.jsx (58 lines), constants.js (26 lines for cycle, 538 for dragdrop) are properly extracted with named exports.

PregnancyToggle is self-contained: it directly writes to localStorage ('mamandouce_pregnant', 'mamandouce_due_date') AND calls onPregnant(dpaStr) — same dual-write behavior as original, no regression.
dragdrop/constants.js: ITEM_ROUTES does NOT include routes for postpartum sub-items (breastfeeding, diapers, etc.) — they fall through to default click handler. Pre-existing, not from refactor.
Home page items are rendered via i18n translation keys (journey.sections.preconception → 'En route vers la grossesse'); the ITEM_NAMES map is the fallback only — refactor preserves this behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on refactor smoke checks (no React crash, no new console errors, gradients/icons render, imports resolve); deep modal flows not exercised in this iteration due to onboarding+drill-down UI gate
